handbookNote: Illinois Real Estate Managing Broker exam question bank. For this pool-depth backfill pass (2026-08-31), the 196 live questions were exported directly from D1 and split by their existing 'topic' column into 7 bucket files under il_re_broker_questions/ (Additional Illinois Laws and Regulations 30, Agency Relationships & Brokerage Practices 35, Disciplinary Provisions & Escrow Handling 25, Disclosures 20, Licensing Requirements 10, Managing Broker Financing/Contracts & Calculations 31, Managing Broker Supervisory Duties & Special Accounts 45) to serve as inventory/style reference for backfill agents. Backfill new-question IDs use prefix 'il_re_broker-deepen1-*', which does not collide with the original 'il_managing_broker-b1-*' IDs already in D1.
